data.title: Werth-Holz Seeks Court-Backed Restructuring Amid Wood Industry Crisis
data.description:
Werth-Holz SA ( (PL:WHH) ) has issued an update.

Werth-Holz S.A. has filed an application with the District Court to open accelerated arrangement proceedings, seeking to restructure its liabilities while continuing operations in wooden garden accessories. The move follows a structural crisis in the wood processing sector, rising Asian competition, sharply higher input costs and weakening demand, all of which have eroded profitability and liquidity.

Management notes that Werth-Holz’s assets significantly exceed its liabilities, its debt structure is transparent and disputed claims are relatively limited, supporting the chosen restructuring route. Under court‑approved protection, the company aims to optimize fixed costs and adjust production capacity to market conditions, while clarifying that the proceedings do not cover the group’s energy‑efficient housing business run by Enoviahaus.

data.title: Cox de México Signs Contract for Major Rosarito Desalination Plant
data.description:

Cox de México has signed a public works contract, alongside Spain-based Cox Engineering & Services S.L., to build the Rosarito seawater desalination and pumping plant that will supply drinking water to Tijuana and Playas de Rosarito in Baja California. The project covers full engineering, procurement and construction of reverse-osmosis infrastructure capable of producing 2,200 liters of potable water per second, providing a complementary water source that enhances regional resilience and consolidates Cox’s position in large-scale water security solutions in Mexico.

By diversifying water supply sources, the Rosarito plant is expected to strengthen long-term water security for Baja California’s urban centers while showcasing Cox de México’s technical and operational capacity in critical public infrastructure. The initiative underscores the company’s strategic role in addressing water scarcity challenges and may reinforce its standing with government clients and investors who prioritize sustainable and resilient water systems.
